title: ARCGym: Benchmarking Deep Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Robotic Colonoscopy
summary: Simulations for learning-based autonomous colonoscopic navigation focus mainly on fully actuated capsule robots, failing to capture the contact-rich navigation of long and flexible clinical colonoscopes. We present the Autonomous Robotic Colonoscopy Gym (ARCGym), an open-source reinforcement learning environment and benchmark for image-based navigation in clinically derived deformable colon anatomies. ARCGym supports multiple types of colonoscope robots, spanning capsule robots and flexible endoscopes, with this work focusing on flexible endoscopes including magnetic-driven tip actuation and clinically used proximally translational actuation. This work includes five CT-reconstructed colons representing typical clinical scenarios, a set of clinically meaningful navigation subtasks, and unified success metrics. We introduce a reward combining depth-based lumen alignment with a lumen-visibility score to improve learning under occlusions. Experiments across tasks, robots, and anatomies show that autonomous navigation remains challenging for both magnetic-driven and proximal-insertion flexible robots, with proximal-insertion actuation remaining an open problem.
tldr: ARCGym is an open-source reinforcement learning benchmark for image-based autonomous colonoscopy navigation, supporting both magnetic-tip and proximal-insertion flexible endoscopes in CT-reconstructed deformable colon anatomies, with clinically motivated subtasks, a lumen-alignment reward, and unified success metrics showing that flexible-scope navigation remains challenging.
tldr_zh: ARCGym 是一个面向自主结肠镜导航的开源强化学习基准，支持磁驱动尖端和近端推进式柔性内窥镜，在基于CT重建的可变形结肠解剖结构中提供临床相关子任务、基于 lumen 对齐的奖励和统一成功指标，实验表明柔性内窥镜自主导航仍具挑战性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于学习方法的自主结肠镜导航模拟主要集中于全驱动胶囊机器人，未能捕捉长而灵活的临床结肠镜在接触丰富环境中的导航特性。我们提出了自主机器人结肠镜检查训练场（ARCGym），这是一个开源的强化学习环境和基准，用于在临床衍生的可变形结肠解剖结构中进行基于图像的导航。ARCGym支持多种类型的结肠镜机器人，涵盖胶囊机器人和柔性内窥镜，本工作重点关注柔性内窥镜，包括磁驱动尖端驱动和临床使用的近端平移驱动。本工作包含五个CT重建的结肠模型，代表典型临床场景，一组具有临床意义的导航子任务，以及统一成功指标。我们引入了一种将基于深度的管腔对齐与管腔可见性评分相结合的奖励机制，以改善遮挡条件下的学习效果。跨任务、机器人和解剖结构的实验表明，对于磁驱动和近端插入式柔性机器人而言，自主导航仍具挑战性，其中近端插入式驱动仍是一个未解决的问题。

title: LD-RSVIS: A Large-Scale and Diverse Benchmark for Referring Surgical Video Instrument Segmentation
summary: Referring surgical video instrument segmentation (RSVIS) aims at segmenting the instrument in a surgical video, given a textual description. Despite recent progress, current models are trained and assessed on relatively small-scale benchmarks, hindering the development of more general RSVIS. In addition, existing benchmarks support only the single-target expression that refers to one instrument in the video, while overlooking multi-target and no-target referring expressions, restricting the applicability of RSVIS in practical scenarios. Addressing these issues, we propose LD-RSVIS, a new benchmark aiming to facilitate more robust and general RSVIS. Specifically, LD-RSVIS consists of 3,536 surgical videos with 1.09 million frames and covers a broad set of 30 instrument classes from 25 various procedures. By including abundant videos and classes, LD-RSVIS could benefit large-scale training and evaluation of more general RSVIS methods. Besides, unlike existing datasets, LD-RSVIS offers diverse referring settings, including no-target, single-target, and multi-target expressions, which enables the development of more practical RSVIS models in real applications. In order to ensure high-quality annotations, all videos in LD-RSVIS are manually labeled with multiple rounds of inspection and refinement. To our knowledge, LD-RSVIS is the largest and most diverse benchmark for RSVIS. To analyze LD-RSVIS and to provide comparison for future research, we evaluate 12 representative methods, and the results reveal that more efforts are required for improvements. To encourage future research, we present a simple yet effective RSVIS method, dubbed Cascade-RSVIS, that first mines target-specific cues using the complementary multi-cue text information and then employs such cues and textual information for segmentation, achieving promising performance. Our benchmark and code will be released.
tldr: LD-RSVIS is a large-scale, diverse benchmark for referring surgical video instrument segmentation, containing 3,536 videos, 1.09M frames, 30 instrument classes, and supporting no-target, single-target, and multi-target expressions. The authors also evaluate 12 existing methods and propose a Cascade-RSVIS baseline that achieves promising performance.
tldr_zh: LD-RSVIS 是一个大规模、多样化的手术视频器械指代分割基准，包含 3,536 个视频、109 万帧、30 类器械，并支持无目标、单目标和多目标指代表达。作者评估了 12 种现有方法，并提出了一种有效的 Cascade-RSVIS 基线方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
指称手术视频器械分割（Referring Surgical Video Instrument Segmentation, RSVIS）旨在根据文本描述，在手术视频中对器械进行分割。尽管近期取得了一定进展，现有模型仍主要在规模较小的基准数据集上进行训练和评估，这阻碍了更具通用性的RSVIS的发展。此外，现有基准仅支持指向视频中单一器械的单目标指称表达，忽略了多目标和无目标指称表达，限制了RSVIS在实际场景中的适用性。针对这些问题，我们提出了LD-RSVIS，一个新的基准数据集，旨在促进更鲁棒、更通用的RSVIS研究。具体而言，LD-RSVIS包含3,536段手术视频，共109万帧，覆盖来自25种不同手术类型的30个器械类别。通过引入丰富的视频和类别，LD-RSVIS有助于更大规模的训练和更通用的RSVIS方法的评估。此外，与现有数据集不同，LD-RSVIS提供了多样化的指称设置，包括无目标、单目标和多目标表达，从而支持开发更贴近实际应用的RSVIS模型。为确保标注质量，LD-RSVIS中的所有视频均经过人工标注，并进行了多轮检查与修正。据我们所知，LD-RSVIS是规模最大、最多样化的RSVIS基准。为了分析LD-RSVIS并为未来研究提供比较基准，我们评估了12种代表性方法，结果表明仍需进一步努力以提升性能。为促进未来研究，我们提出了一种简单而有效的RSVIS方法，称为Cascade-RSVIS，该方法首先利用互补的多线索文本信息挖掘目标特定线索，然后利用这些线索和文本信息进行分割，取得了令人满意的性能。我们的基准数据集和代码将公开发布。

title: Tracker-Free Robotic Ultrasound Calibration with a Spherical-Marker Phantom and Threshold-Free Center Localization
summary: Robotic ultrasound (US) calibration is essential for accurately relating US images to the robot coordinate system, but accurate and automated calibration remains challenging because existing methods often require complex phantoms or external 3D trackers. In this work, we develop a tracker-free robotic US calibration framework using a spherical-marker phantom and a highly automated perception pipeline for sphere-center localization. The proposed threshold-free image-processing method localizes the spherical feature based on each US image's intensity distribution, eliminating hand-tuned intensity thresholds and improving robustness across imaging settings without per-system retuning. Multi-pose observations of the spherical fiducial are then used to estimate the US-to-EE transformation without external tracking or prior localization of the sphere center in the robot base frame. We validate the proposed framework on a robotic US platform through repeated sphere scans and further assess the calibrated system using geometrically distinct phantoms with known CAD models. Across 12 cross-validation folds, single-marker calibration achieved sphere-center accuracy and precision of $1.75\pm0.51$ mm and $0.85\pm0.11$ mm, respectively, compared with $1.72\pm0.51$ mm and $0.84\pm0.12$ mm for three-marker calibration. Across the three reconstruction sets, the single-marker calibration yielded pooled post-registration point-to-surface MAE$\pm$SD values of $0.41\pm0.35$ mm for the cone and $0.50\pm0.41$ mm for the triangular prism, closely matching the three-marker results of $0.40\pm0.35$ mm and $0.48\pm0.40$ mm, respectively.
tldr: This paper presents a tracker-free robotic ultrasound calibration framework using a spherical-marker phantom and a threshold-free sphere-center localization pipeline, estimating the ultrasound-to-end-effector transform from multi-pose observations without external tracking. Validation shows single-marker calibration accuracy comparable to three-marker calibration across geometric phantoms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种无跟踪器的机器人超声校准框架，利用球形标记体模和免阈值球心定位流程，通过多姿态观测估计超声图像到机器人末端执行器的变换。实验表明，单标记校准精度与三标记校准相当。
summary_zh: 摘要：机器人超声（US）标定对于将超声图像与机器人坐标系准确关联至关重要，但精确且自动化的标定仍具挑战性，因为现有方法通常需要复杂的体模或外部3D跟踪器。在本工作中，我们开发了一种无跟踪器的机器人超声标定框架，采用球形标记体模和高度自动化的感知流程实现球心定位。所提出的无阈值图像处理方法基于每幅超声图像的强度分布来定位球形特征，消除了手动调整的强度阈值，并提高了跨成像设置的鲁棒性，无需针对每个系统重新调参。随后，利用球形基准的多姿态观测来估计超声到末端执行器（US-to-EE）的变换，无需外部跟踪或预先在机器人基坐标系中定位球心。我们在机器人超声平台上通过重复球体扫描验证了所提框架，并使用具有已知CAD模型的几何不同体模进一步评估标定系统。在12折交叉验证中，单标记标定的球心精度和重复性分别为$1.75\pm0.51$ mm和$0.85\pm0.11$ mm，而三标记标定分别为$1.72\pm0.51$ mm和$0.84\pm0.12$ mm。在三个重建集合中，单标记标定在配准后点对面平均绝对误差（MAE）±标准差（SD）上，圆锥体为$0.41\pm0.35$ mm，三棱柱为$0.50\pm0.41$ mm，与三标记标定的结果（分别为$0.40\pm0.35$ mm和$0.48\pm0.40$ mm）非常接近。

title: Prescribed-Time Contracting-Boundary Control of a Tendon-Driven Flexible Arm
summary: This study develops a prescribed-time performance-shaping control method for curvature tracking of a single-segment flexible arm actuated by three antagonistic tendon pairs. A Cartesian curvature representation is introduced to avoid the undefined bending direction at the straight configuration and to establish an explicit six-tendon kinematic mapping. A cubic performance boundary contracts smoothly from an initially admissible error bound to a nonzero terminal accuracy bound within a prescribed time. Based on this boundary, a dual transformation combining static symmetric error scaling and time-varying behavior shaping maps the tracking error into a fixed unit box. The resulting controller guarantees boundary invariance, prescribed-time entry into the terminal accuracy region, and subsequent asymptotic convergence. Numerical evaluations with Python and OpenCR--MuJoCo, together with a supervised reduced-order experiment on a two-section, four-channel platform, provide complementary validation. Across six experimental trials, no violation of the prescribed boundary is observed, and the proposed controller reduces the mean terminal curvature RMSE by 32.5% relative to a matched baseline, with comparable terminal-band entry times. These results support the feasibility of the proposed approach in the reduced-order experimental setting.
tldr: This paper proposes a prescribed-time performance-shaping controller for curvature tracking of a tendon-driven flexible arm, using a Cartesian curvature representation and a contracting cubic error boundary with a dual error transformation. Numerical simulations and a reduced-order experiment show reduced curvature tracking error without boundary violations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种预设时间性能整形控制方法，用于肌腱驱动柔性臂的曲率跟踪，通过笛卡尔曲率表示与收缩误差边界及双变换，保证边界不变性和预设时间进入终端精度区域；数值仿真与降阶实验显示曲率RMSE较基线降低32.5%。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种预设时间性能塑造控制方法，用于实现由三对拮抗肌腱驱动的单段柔性臂的曲率跟踪。引入笛卡尔曲率表示，以避免直线构型下弯曲方向未定义的问题，并建立显式的六肌腱运动学映射。三次性能边界在预设时间内从初始允许误差界平滑收缩至非零终态精度界。基于该边界，采用静态对称误差缩放与时变行为塑造相结合的双重变换，将跟踪误差映射至固定单位盒内。所设计的控制器保证了边界不变性、预设时间内进入终态精度区域以及随后的渐近收敛。基于Python和OpenCR--MuJoCo的数值评估，以及在两段四通道平台上开展的监督降阶实验，提供了互补性的验证。在六次实验中，未观察到违反预设边界的情况，且与匹配基线相比，所提控制器将终态曲率均方根误差平均值降低了32.5%，同时终态带进入时间相当。这些结果支持了所提方法在降阶实验环境中的可行性。

title: Embodied Snap: Octopus-Inspired Distributed Reach-and-Attach with a Speed-Limited Soft Arm
summary: Reach-and-attach of soft robotic arms with passive suction requires accurate targeting and sufficient contact speed, yet geared actuators can impose a speed limit that improved trajectory tracking alone cannot overcome. This paper proposes an embodied snap controller that separates slow servo-driven preloading from rapid elastic release, enabling a compliant arm to move beyond its direct tendon-driven speed limit. Octopus biology motivates the controller's section-wise organizational prior, rather than reproduction of the octopus nervous system. A learned policy shared across three sections selects preloads, aim, tendon slack, and release timing, determining where, how, and when to load and release the body. The policy is optimized offline using a hardware-validated recurrent model within experimentally supported bounds. Across five optimization seeds and 400 unseen simulated targets, attachment success is $(73\pm4)\%$ at a $5\text{ cm}$ lateral tolerance, and the shared policy reaches the matched centralized controller's mean final reward after a median $17\%$ of the common evaluation budget. Hardware characterization achieves tip speeds of 1.56-1.64 m/s, at least $108\%$ above direct tendon-driven release. In 18 open-loop hardware trials across six placements, 17 exceed the 1 m/s snap threshold and nine retrieve the object, with successful retrieval at five placements. These results demonstrate a practical division of responsibility in the control problem: learned control prepares the body, and passive body mechanics execute the rapid movement needed for dynamic reach-and-attach.
tldr: This paper proposes an embodied snap controller for a soft robotic arm that separates slow servo preloading from rapid elastic release, enabling dynamic reach-and-attach beyond the tendon-driven speed limit. A shared learned policy selects preloads and release timing, and hardware experiments demonstrate faster tip speeds and successful object retrieval.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种具身“弹射”控制器，将软体机械臂的慢速伺服预载与快速弹性释放分离，使其超越腱驱动速度限制，实现动态到达与吸附。共享学习策略决定预载与释放时机，硬件实验验证了更高的末端速度和物体抓取成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：具有被动吸附功能的软体机械臂在“伸达-附着”任务中需要精确的目标瞄准和足够的接触速度，然而齿轮驱动执行器可能带来速度限制，仅靠改进轨迹跟踪无法克服。本文提出了一种具身弹射控制器，将缓慢的伺服驱动预加载与快速的弹性释放分离，使柔顺机械臂能够超越其直接腱驱动速度极限。章鱼的生物特性启发了该控制器在节段层面的组织先验，而非对章鱼神经系统的复现。一个在三个节段间共享的学习策略选择预加载量、瞄准方向、腱松弛度和释放时机，确定何时、何地以及如何加载和释放本体。该策略在实验验证的边界内，使用硬件验证的循环模型进行离线优化。在五个优化随机种子和400个未见过的模拟目标中，在5厘米横向容差下附着成功率为$(73\pm4)\%$，且共享策略在达到匹配的集中式控制器平均最终奖励时，仅使用了公共评估预算的中位数17%。硬件表征实现了1.56-1.64 m/s的末端速度，至少比直接腱驱动释放高出108%。在六个放置位置进行的18次开环硬件试验中，17次超过1 m/s的弹射阈值，九次成功取回物体，其中五个放置位置取回成功。这些结果展示了控制问题中一种实用的责任分工：学习控制负责准备身体，被动身体力学执行动态伸达-附着所需的快速运动。

title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
summary: Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface. We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN by up to 18.3 points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline. We further explore multimodal in-context learning for report generation, showing additional improvements without updating model parameters. Overall, QwenVLConnector offers a unified and efficient framework for combining structured medical perception with open-ended clinical text generation. Our code can be found at https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector.
tldr: QwenVLConnector extends Qwen2.5-VL with a lightweight multi-layer Connector that fuses multi-level visual features into visual tokens, enabling a unified medical chatbot for classification, detection, counting, regression, and report generation, and improving FLARE-2D tasks over the baseline.
tldr_zh: QwenVLConnector 在 Qwen2.5-VL 基础上增加轻量级多层连接器，将不同层级视觉特征融合进视觉 token，在统一框架中支持分类、检测、计数、回归和报告生成，并在 FLARE-2D 上优于基线模型。
summary_zh: 大多数医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在开放式报告生成和VQA任务上表现出色，但在统一接口下对结构化、细粒度临床感知的支持有限。我们提出QwenVLConnector，一种基于Qwen2.5-VL的医学聊天机器人，将分类、多标签分类、文本化检测、计数、回归和自由形式报告生成统一在单一的下一个词元目标下。我们的关键组件是一个轻量级稠密多层连接器，它聚合低层和高层视觉特征，通过预训练的视觉Merger进行对齐，并将其与最终视觉表示融合，且不增加序列长度。该设计在保持效率的同时，用互补的空间和语义线索丰富了视觉词元。在FLARE-2D上，QwenVLConnector将检测F1从0.55提升至0.85，将单标签分类从0.37提升至0.51，并将报告生成的GREEN分数相对于Qwen2.5-VL基线最高提升18.3个百分点。我们进一步探索了用于报告生成的多模态上下文学习，在不更新模型参数的情况下实现了额外改进。总体而言，QwenVLConnector为将结构化医学感知与开放式临床文本生成相结合提供了一个统一且高效的框架。我们的代码可在https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector获取。

title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage framework for personalized sleep guidance: Stage 1 uses a multi-agent LLM pipeline to generate structured guidance from unannotated wearable data (creating datasets), and Stage 2 distills these reasoning trajectories into small language models via supervised fine-tuning plus Best-of-N selection for local deployment. Claims outperformance over commercial and open LLMs.
tldr_zh: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用多智能体LLM从无标注可穿戴数据生成结构化睡眠指导，构建数据集；第二阶段通过监督微调和Best-of-N选择将推理轨迹蒸馏到小语言模型，支持本地部署。宣称优于商业通用/医疗LLM及开源模型。
summary_zh: 摘要：利用可穿戴数据进行睡眠监测在个人健康领域展现出良好前景，然而基于大语言模型（LLM）的摘要生成与问答仍不足以提供个性化的睡眠指导。训练专用模型通常需要昂贵的专家标注。此外，隐私和可及性问题促使终端用户采用轻量化的本地部署方案。我们提出一个两阶段框架来应对这些挑战。具体而言，在第一阶段，多智能体LLM流水线从未标注的可穿戴记录中推理出结构化的睡眠指导，从而支持可扩展的数据集构建。第二阶段通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏到小语言模型（SLM）中，并集成一种无需训练的Best-of-N选择策略以增强推理能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于商业通用及医学大语言模型和开源模型。人工评估进一步验证了所生成指导的质量，以及使用小语言模型实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。

title: BrainIAC: Interactive 3D Brain Lesion Segmentation across Heterogeneous MRI Modalities with Online Adaptation
summary: Brain lesion segmentation is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, playing a critical role in diagnosis, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. Yet existing models still struggle to meet the demands of real clinical use, where deployments contain data distribution shifts, arising from differences in scanner hardware, imaging protocol (varying MRI modality sets), and new pathologies. We present BrainIAC (Brain lesion Interactive Adaptive Continuously learning segmentation), a unified framework that integrates (i) a multi-modal backbone network trained to segment multiple types of brain lesions and handle heterogeneous sets of modalities via zero-filling and random modality dropping; (ii) 3D interactive segmentation with bounding-box and click prompts that preserves fully automatic prediction when no prompt is given; and (iii) an online adaptation mechanism combining Mid-Interaction adaptation and Post-Interaction adaptation, supervised by the network's own predictions as pseudo labels and guided by an extra Click-Centered Gaussian loss. To our knowledge, this is one of the first 3D online adaptation methods for interactive segmentation, and the first to combine handling of heterogeneous modality sets with online adaptation. Experiments across seven brain MRI datasets demonstrate that the proposed components provide complementary and synergistic benefits. The method consistently outperforms existing approaches and generalizes well across heterogeneous imaging modalities, including those unseen during training, as well as previously unseen brain pathology types. The code and a 3D Slicer plug-in will be released at https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC upon publication.
tldr: BrainIAC is a unified framework for 3D brain lesion segmentation that handles heterogeneous MRI modalities, supports interactive bounding-box/click prompts with automatic mode, and uses online adaptation with pseudo-labels and a Click-Centered Gaussian loss to generalize across unseen modalities and pathologies.
tldr_zh: BrainIAC 是一个统一的3D脑病灶分割框架，可处理异质MRI模态，支持边界框/点击提示的交互式分割并在无提示时保持全自动，同时通过基于伪标签和点击中心高斯损失的在线自适应，泛化到未见过的模态和病理类型。
summary_zh: 脑病变分割是医学图像分析中的一项基础任务，在诊断、治疗规划和纵向疾病监测中发挥关键作用。然而，现有模型仍难以满足真实临床使用的需求，因为在临床部署中常出现数据分布偏移，这些偏移源于扫描仪硬件的差异、成像协议（不同的MRI模态组合）以及新出现的病理类型。我们提出了BrainIAC（Brain lesion Interactive Adaptive Continuously learning segmentation），一个统一框架，集成了：（i）一个多模态骨干网络，通过零填充和随机模态丢弃进行训练，可分割多种类型的脑病变并处理异构模态组合；（ii）基于边界框和点击提示的3D交互式分割，在未提供提示时仍保持全自动预测能力；（iii）一种结合中等交互适配与后期交互适配的在线自适应机制，以网络自身的预测作为伪标签进行监督，并由额外的点击中心高斯损失引导。据我们所知，这是首批用于交互式分割的3D在线自适应方法之一，也是首个将异构模态组合处理与在线自适应相结合的方法。在七个脑MRI数据集上的实验表明，所提出的各组件具有互补和协同效应。该方法 consistently 优于现有方法，并在异构成像模态（包括训练中未见过的模态）以及先前未见的脑病理类型上均表现出良好的泛化能力。代码和3D Slicer插件将在发表后于 https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC 发布。
